name: China Renaissance Holdings Limited
summary: China Renaissance Holdings Limited engages in the provision of investment banking and investment management services in Mainland China, Hong Kong, and the United States. It operates through Investment Banking, Investment Management, CR Securities, and Others segments. The company offers financial advisory, and merger and acquisition advisory services; as well as equity underwriting, sales, trading, brokerage, and research services. It also provides fund and asset management services for individual and institutional clients, as well as manages its investment in funds.
